proposals.before: Give each destitute household a draft ox.
proposals.after: The poor who wholly lack assets and cannot support themselves shall each be granted one ox.
proposals.sourceQuote: 貧者全無資產，不能自存，各賜牧牛一頭。
proposals.sourceReason: 全無資產，不能自存 identifies the recipients; the bare grant leaves that description out without forcing a draft/herding label.

proposals.before: Whoever wishes to rent state oxen and state land may do so under Wei–Jin precedent.
proposals.after: If any have surplus private labor and gladly take official oxen to reclaim official fields, let them follow the old Wei and Jin rules.
proposals.sourceQuote: 若私有餘力，樂取官牛墾官田者，其依魏、晉舊法。
proposals.sourceReason: 私有餘力 and 墾官田 specify surplus labor reclaiming official fields under Wei-Jin rules.

proposals.before: Dig irrigation works for public and private good—let engineers plan every channel.
proposals.after: Irrigation ditches and channels benefit public and private interests; let the responsible officials plan and build them, striving to exhaust the advantages of water and land.
proposals.sourceQuote: 溝洫溉灌，有益官私，主者量造，務盡水陸之勢。
proposals.sourceReason: 主者 are responsible officials, not engineers, and 務盡水陸之勢 remains the construction aim.

proposals.before: Wang Xian and Liu Ming although their crimes ought to be banned and dismissed, also is my lacking great measure.
proposals.after: Wang Xian and Liu Ming, although their offenses warrant ban and dismissal, also show my own lack of great forbearance.
proposals.sourceQuote: 王憲、劉明雖其罪應禁黜，亦猶孤之無大量也。
proposals.sourceReason: 罪應禁黜 warrants ban and dismissal of the persons; saying crimes ought to be banned and dismissed misassigns the object.

proposals.before: Feng Yu spoke as a true minister should.
proposals.after: Master Feng is steadfastly upright and deeply embodies the character of a royal minister.
proposals.sourceQuote: 封生蹇蹇，深得王臣之體。
proposals.sourceReason: 封生蹇蹇，深得王臣之體 praises steadfast ministerial character; the thin current en drops both clauses.

proposals.before: He tested students at the eastern school and promoted the best as attendants.
proposals.after: Huang personally went to the eastern school to examine students; those whose command of the classics was thorough and outstanding were promoted to fill posts as close attendants.
proposals.sourceQuote: 皝親臨東庠考試學生，其經通秀異者，擢充近侍。
proposals.sourceReason: 經通秀異者 is the classical-proficiency criterion for promotion, not a bare the best.

proposals.before: He remitted rent during a drought.
proposals.after: Because of the prolonged drought, he remitted the common people's field rent.
proposals.sourceReason: Independent of the literal proposal, 久旱 and 百姓田租 require prolonged drought and commoners' field rent in en.

proposals.before: He grouped refugees from Bohai, Hejian, Guangping, Wei, Donglai, Beihai, and Wu into new counties under Yan.
proposals.after: He made the Bohai people into Xingji County, the Hejian people into Ningji County, the Guangping and Wei commandery people into Xingping County, the Donglai and Beihai people into Yuli County, and the Wu people into Wu County, all subordinate to the state of Yan.
proposals.sourceQuote: 以勃海人為興集縣，河間人為寧集縣，廣平、魏郡人為興平縣，東萊、北海人為育黎縣，吳人為吳縣，悉隸燕國。
proposals.sourceReason: Each settler group and its new county under Yan must be named; unnamed new counties omit those mappings.

proposals.before: Again measure affairs to establish offices, measure offices to appoint men, so that offices match need and men do not hold empty posts; estimate yearly revenue and trim salaries accordingly.
proposals.after: Again measure affairs to establish offices, measure offices to appoint men, so that offices match need and men do not hold empty posts; estimate the amount of annual revenue and determine their salaries accordingly.
proposals.sourceQuote: 又量事置官，量官置人，使官必稱須，人不虛位，度歲入多少，裁而祿之。
proposals.sourceReason: 裁而祿之 means determine remuneration in proportion to estimated annual income, not necessarily trim or cut salaries.

proposals.before: Those who labor in the fields receive banners of distinction, while idle farmers suffer the penalty of being unranked.
proposals.after: Those who labor in the fields receive rewards of public commendation and distinction, while idle farmers suffer the penalty of exclusion from standing among their peers.
proposals.sourceQuote: 力田者受旌顯之賞，惰農者有不齒之罰。
proposals.sourceReason: 旌顯 means publicly commend and distinguish; it does not specify a physical banner. 不齒 is exclusion from standing among one’s peers.

proposals.before: Food must be taken from those who plow to feed others; one man eating the strength of one man, with tens of thousands idling, the loss is likewise; how can one achieve provision for every household and govern to peaceful ascendancy!
proposals.after: Food must be taken from those who plow to feed them; one person consumes the labor of one person, and with tens of thousands living without working, the loss is likewise in the tens of thousands; how can every household be provided for and every person have enough, and government bring about peace!
proposals.sourceQuote: 必取於耕者而食之，一人食一人之力，游食數萬，損亦如之，安可以家給人足，治致升平！
proposals.sourceReason: 一人食一人之力 explicitly gives the one-to-one labor burden, 損亦如之 extends it to tens of thousands, and 家給人足 requires both household provision and personal sufficiency.

proposals.before: If not, add punishment and execution, so the realm knows the court follows good like flowing water and punishes evil without delay.
proposals.after: If not, impose punishment and execution on me at once, so the realm knows the court follows good like flowing water and punishes evil without delay.
proposals.sourceQuote: 非也，登加罪戮，使天下知朝廷從善如流，罰惡不淹。
proposals.sourceReason: 登 adds immediacy to 加罪戮. The current literal includes execution but omits this explicit demand for prompt action.

sourceUnits.zh: 慕容皝
sourceUnits.en: Murong Huang.
sourceUnits.literal: Murong Huang.

sourceUnits.zh: 以牧牛給貧家，田于苑中，公收其八，二分入私。
sourceUnits.en: Poor households received draft oxen to till the royal park on an eighty-twenty revenue split with the state.
sourceUnits.literal: Used herding oxen given to poor families, fields in the royal park, the public took eight-tenths, two-tenths went private.

sourceUnits.zh: 有牛而無地者，亦田苑中，公收其七，三分入私。
sourceUnits.en: Householders who owned cattle but no land tilled the park on a seventy-thirty split.
sourceUnits.literal: Those with oxen but without land, also fielded in the park, the public took seven-tenths, three-tenths went private.

sourceUnits.zh: 皝記室參軍封裕諫曰：臣聞聖王之宰國也，薄賦而藏于百姓，分之以三等之田，十一而稅之；
sourceUnits.en: Murong Huang's secretary Feng Yu remonstrated: I have heard that a sage king keeps taxes light and stores wealth among the people, divides land into three grades, and levies one part in ten;
sourceUnits.literal: Murong Huang's secretary-advisor Feng Yu remonstrated, saying: Your servant has heard that when a sage king governs a state, he keeps taxes light and stores wealth among the people, divides land into three grades, and levies one part in ten;

sourceUnits.zh: 寒者衣之，饑者食之，使家給人足。
sourceUnits.en: he clothes the cold and feeds the hungry until every household is provided for.
sourceUnits.literal: He clothes the cold and feeds the hungry, so that every household is provided for and every person has enough.

sourceUnits.zh: 雖水旱而不為災者，何也？
sourceUnits.en: Why then are flood and drought not disaster?
sourceUnits.literal: Though there be flood or drought, why is it not disaster?

sourceUnits.zh: 高選農官，務盡勸課，人治周田百畝，亦不假牛力；
sourceUnits.en: Because high agricultural officers are chosen and encouragement enforced, each man tends a full hundred mu without borrowing oxen;
sourceUnits.literal: Select agricultural officers with care, strive to the utmost in encouragement and assessment; each man tends a full hundred mu of field and does not borrow ox power;

sourceUnits.zh: 力田者受旌顯之賞，惰農者有不齒之罰。
sourceUnits.en: those who labor receive honors and the idle are punished.
sourceUnits.literal: Those who labor in the fields receive banners of distinction, while idle farmers suffer the penalty of being unranked.

sourceUnits.zh: 又量事置官，量官置人，使官必稱須，人不虛位，度歲入多少，裁而祿之。
sourceUnits.en: Offices are matched to need, men do not hold empty posts, and salaries are trimmed to yearly revenue.
sourceUnits.literal: Again measure affairs to establish offices, measure offices to appoint men, so that offices match need and men do not hold empty posts; estimate yearly revenue and trim salaries accordingly.

sourceUnits.zh: 供百僚之外，藏之太倉，三年之耕，餘一年之粟。
sourceUnits.en: Beyond supplying officials, grain is stored in the Great Granary until three years' plowing leaves one year's surplus.
sourceUnits.literal: Beyond supplying the hundred officials, store in the Great Granary; three years' plowing leaves one year's grain surplus.

sourceUnits.zh: 以斯而積，公用于何不足？
sourceUnits.en: Stored thus, how could public use fail?
sourceUnits.literal: Accumulated thus, how could public use be insufficient?

sourceUnits.zh: 水旱其如百姓何！
sourceUnits.en: Flood and drought, what can they do to the people!
sourceUnits.literal: Flood and drought, what can they do to the people!

sourceUnits.zh: 雖務農之令屢發，二千石令長莫有志勤在公、銳盡地利者。
sourceUnits.en: Yet though farming orders issue repeatedly, no magistrate or two-thousand-bushel official works the land with public zeal.
sourceUnits.literal: Though orders to promote agriculture are repeatedly issued, among the two-thousand-bushel administrators and magistrates none are intent on public diligence or keen to exhaust the land's advantage.

sourceUnits.zh: 故漢祖知其如此，以墾田不實，征殺二千石以十數，是以明、章之際，號次升平。
sourceUnits.en: Knowing this, Han's founder executed more than ten such officials for false land reports, and under Ming and Zhang the age was nearly peaceful.
sourceUnits.literal: Therefore Han's founder, knowing this, executed more than ten such officials for false reports of reclaimed fields, and in the Ming and Zhang era the age was called nearly peaceful.

sourceUnits.zh: 自永嘉喪亂，百姓流亡，中原蕭條，千里無煙，饑寒流隕，相繼溝壑。
sourceUnits.en: Since the Yongjia calamity the people have fled; the central plain is desolate and hunger fills the ditches.
sourceUnits.literal: Since the Yongjia calamity the people have fled; the central plain is desolate, for a thousand li no smoke rises; hunger and cold flow in ruin and men fall one after another into ditches and gullies.

sourceUnits.zh: 先王以神武聖略，保全一方，威以殄奸，德以懷遠，故九州之人，塞表殊類，繈負萬里，若赤子之歸慈父，流人之多舊土十倍有餘，人殷地狹，故無田者十有四焉。
sourceUnits.en: Murong Hui, by divine martial strategy, preserved this region, destroyed traitors by might and won the distant by virtue; people of the nine provinces and foreign tribes came carrying infants for ten thousand li like children to a loving father. Refugees outnumbered the old population more than tenfold; land was scarce and four in ten had no fields.
sourceUnits.literal: The former king, by divine martial sage strategy, preserved one region; by might he destroyed traitors and by virtue he won the distant; therefore people of the nine provinces and foreign tribes beyond the frontier came carrying infants for ten thousand li, like infants returning to a loving father; the displaced exceeded the old population more than tenfold, the people were many and the land narrow, so those without fields were four in ten.

sourceUnits.zh: 殿下以英聖之資，克廣先業，南摧強趙，東滅句麗，開境三千，戶增十萬，繼武闡廣之功，有高西伯。
sourceUnits.en: Your Highness, with heroic endowment, has extended the former enterprise: south you crushed strong Zhao, east you destroyed Goguryeo, opened three thousand li and added a hundred thousand households, rivaling the great Earl of the West.
sourceUnits.literal: Your Highness, with heroic and sage endowment, has been able to extend the former enterprise: south you crushed strong Zhao, east you destroyed Goguryeo, opened three thousand li of border and increased households by a hundred thousand, continuing the merit of martial expansion, rivaling the great Earl of the West.

sourceUnits.zh: 宜省罷諸苑，以業流人。
sourceUnits.en: Reduce the royal parks and settle refugees on the land.
sourceUnits.literal: It is fitting to reduce and abolish the parks and estates and settle the displaced on them.

sourceUnits.zh: 人至而無資產者，賜之以牧牛。
sourceUnits.en: Grant cattle to those who arrive without property.
sourceUnits.literal: Those who arrive without property should be granted cattle to herd.

sourceUnits.zh: 人既殿下之人，牛豈失乎！
sourceUnits.en: If the people are yours, how could the cattle be lost!
sourceUnits.literal: If the people are Your Highness's people, how could the cattle be lost!

sourceUnits.zh: 善藏者藏于百姓，若斯而已矣。
sourceUnits.en: True storage is storage among the people; that is all.
sourceUnits.literal: Those who store well store among the people; that is all.

sourceUnits.zh: 邇者深副樂土之望，中國之人皆將壺餐奉迎，石季龍誰與居乎！
sourceUnits.en: Recently you have deeply fulfilled the hope of a happy land; the people of China will all bring food to welcome you. Who then will remain with Shi Hu?
sourceUnits.literal: Recently you have deeply fulfilled the hope of a happy land; the people of China will all bring food to welcome you; Shi Jilong—who will dwell with him!

sourceUnits.zh: 且魏、晉雖道消之世，猶削百姓不至於七八，持官牛田者官得六分，百姓得四分，私牛而官田者與官中分，百姓安之，人皆悅樂。
sourceUnits.en: Even Wei and Jin, though the Way faded, did not reduce the people below seven or eight tenths; official-ox farmers gave six parts to the state and four to the people, private-ox farmers split evenly, and all rejoiced.
sourceUnits.literal: Even Wei and Jin, though an age of fading Way, still did not reduce the people below seven or eight tenths; those who farmed with official oxen gave six parts to the state and four to the people; those with private oxen on official land split evenly with the state; the people were secure and all rejoiced.

sourceUnits.zh: 臣猶曰非明王之道，而況增乎！
sourceUnits.en: I still say this is not the way of a clear king, and how much more if burdens increase!
sourceUnits.literal: Your servant still says this is not the way of a clear king, and how much more if it is increased!

sourceUnits.zh: 且水旱之厄，堯、湯所不免，王者宜浚治溝澮，循鄭白、西門、史起溉灌之法，旱則決溝為雨，水則入於溝瀆，上無《雲漢》之憂，下無昏墊之患。
sourceUnits.en: Flood and drought, which Yao and Tang did not escape, require dredged canals and irrigation after the Zheng and Bai canals and the methods of Ximen and Shi Qi; drought is eased by opening channels to supply water like rain, and floodwaters are directed into drainage channels, so that above there is no anxiety like that expressed in Yunhan and below there is no misery from inundation.
sourceUnits.literal: Moreover flood and drought are misfortunes Yao and Tang did not escape; a king ought to dredge and maintain canals and ditches, following the Zheng and Bai canals and the irrigation methods of Ximen and Shi Qi; in drought open ditches as rain, in flood send water into channels; above no worry like the "Yunhan," below no trouble of mire and flood.

sourceUnits.zh: 句麗、百濟及宇文、段部之人，皆兵勢所徙，非如中國慕義而至，咸有思歸之心。
sourceUnits.en: Goguryeo, Baekje, Yuwen, and Duan peoples were moved by force, not like Chinese who came admiring righteousness; all long to return home.
sourceUnits.literal: The people of Goguryeo, Baekje, and the Yuwen and Duan tribes were all moved by military force, not like those of China who came admiring righteousness; all have hearts that long to return.

sourceUnits.zh: 今戶垂十萬，狹湊都城，恐方將為國家深害，宜分其兄弟宗屬，徙于西境諸城，撫之以恩，檢之以法，使不得散在居人，知國之虛實。
sourceUnits.en: With households nearing a hundred thousand crowded against the capital, divide their kindred and move them to western border cities, ruling them with kindness and law so they do not learn the state's strength and weakness.
sourceUnits.literal: Now households approach a hundred thousand, crowded narrow against the capital; I fear this will soon become a deep harm to the state; it is fitting to divide their brothers and lineage and move them to western border cities, soothe them with kindness and inspect them with law, so they do not scatter among settled people and learn the state's strength and weakness.

sourceUnits.zh: 今中原未平，資畜宜廣，官司猥多，遊食不少，一夫不耕，歲受其饑。
sourceUnits.en: The central plain is not pacified and stores must grow, yet offices multiply and idlers abound; one man who does not plow makes the year hungrier.
sourceUnits.literal: Now the central plain is not yet pacified and stores ought to be enlarged; official posts are numerous and idlers not few; one man who does not plow, the year receives his hunger.

sourceUnits.zh: 必取於耕者而食之，一人食一人之力，游食數萬，損亦如之，安可以家給人足，治致升平！
sourceUnits.en: Food taken from plowmen feeds idlers; tens of thousands eat without plowing, and the loss is the same; how can every household be provided for and the realm governed to peace!
sourceUnits.literal: Food must be taken from those who plow to feed others; one man eating the strength of one man, with tens of thousands idling, the loss is likewise; how can one achieve provision for every household and govern to peaceful ascendancy!

sourceUnits.zh: 殿下降覽古今之事多矣，政之巨患莫甚於斯。
sourceUnits.en: Your Highness has read past and present; no governmental evil exceeds this.
sourceUnits.literal: Your Highness has read many affairs of past and present; no great evil of government exceeds this.

sourceUnits.zh: 其有經略出世，才稱時求者，自可隨須置之列位。
sourceUnits.en: Men of world-ranging talent may be placed as needed.
sourceUnits.literal: Those with world-ranging strategy and talent suited to the age's needs may be placed in posts as needed.

sourceUnits.zh: 非此已往，其耕而食，蠶而衣，亦天之道也。
sourceUnits.en: Beyond this, plow to eat and raise silkworms to clothe, as heaven ordains.
sourceUnits.literal: Beyond this, to plow and eat, to raise silkworms and clothe, is also heaven's way.

sourceUnits.zh: 殿下聖性寬明，思言若渴，故人盡芻蕘，有犯無隱。
sourceUnits.en: Your Highness is broad and clear, thirsting for counsel; men speak even humble truths without hiding.
sourceUnits.literal: Your Highness is sage in nature, broad and clear, thirsting for words as for water; therefore men exhaust even firewood and grass, offending yet not hiding.

sourceUnits.zh: 前者參軍王憲、大夫劉明並竭忠獻款，以貢至言，雖頗有逆鱗，意在無責。
sourceUnits.en: Staff officer Wang Xian and Grand Master Liu Ming spoke with full loyalty; though they ruffled scales, they meant no offense.
sourceUnits.literal: Formerly the staff officer Wang Xian and Grand Master Liu Ming both exhausted loyalty and offered sincerity, presenting utmost words; though they somewhat ruffled scales, the intent was not to blame.

sourceUnits.zh: 主者奏以妖言犯上，至之于法，殿下慈弘苞納，恕其大辟，猶削黜禁錮，不齒於朝。
sourceUnits.en: Officials charged them with demonic speech; Your Highness pardoned their capital crime yet still barred them from court.
sourceUnits.literal: The responsible officials memorialized that they spoke demonic words offending superiors and brought them to law; Your Highness, merciful and broad in acceptance, pardoned their capital offense yet still demoted, barred, and excluded them from court.

sourceUnits.zh: 其言是也，殿下固宜納之；
sourceUnits.en: If their words were right, you ought to accept them;
sourceUnits.literal: If their words were right, Your Highness ought indeed to accept them;

sourceUnits.zh: 如其非也，宜亮其狂狷。
sourceUnits.en: if not, make allowance for blunt integrity.
sourceUnits.literal: If not, you ought to make allowance for their blunt integrity.

sourceUnits.zh: 罪諫臣而求直言，亦猶北行詣越，豈有得邪！
sourceUnits.en: To punish remonstrating ministers while seeking straight words is like going north to reach Yue!
sourceUnits.literal: To punish remonstrating ministers while seeking straight words is like going north to reach Yue; how can there be gain!

sourceUnits.zh: 右長史宋該等阿媚苟容，輕劾諫士，己無骨鯁，嫉人有之，掩蔽耳目，不忠之甚。
sourceUnits.en: Right chief clerk Song Gai and others flatter, impeach remonstrators lightly, have no backbone yet envy it in others, and cover eyes and ears, most disloyal.
sourceUnits.literal: Right Chief Clerk Song Gai and others flatter and accommodate, lightly impeach remonstrators, themselves without backbone yet jealous when others have it, covering eyes and ears, most disloyal.

sourceUnits.zh: 四業者國之所資，教學者有國盛事。
sourceUnits.en: The four occupations sustain the state; teaching and learning are its great affair.
sourceUnits.literal: The four occupations are what the state relies on; teaching and learning are the state's great affair.

sourceUnits.zh: 習戰務農，尤其本也。
sourceUnits.en: War training and agriculture are especially the root.
sourceUnits.literal: Training for war and promoting agriculture are especially the root.

sourceUnits.zh: 百工商賈，猶其末耳。
sourceUnits.en: Merchants and craftsmen are the branch.
sourceUnits.literal: Merchants and craftsmen are yet the branch.

sourceUnits.zh: 宜量軍國所須，置其員數，已外歸之于農，教之戰法，學者三年無成，亦宜還之于農，不可徒充大員，以塞聰俊之路。
sourceUnits.en: Measure army and state needs, set posts, return the rest to farming, teach battle methods, and send students who fail after three years back to the fields; do not fill posts vainly and block worthy men.
sourceUnits.literal: It is fitting to measure what army and state require, set the number of posts, and return the rest to farming; teach them battle methods; students who after three years have no achievement should also return to farming; they must not vainly fill great posts and block the path of the keen and worthy.

sourceUnits.zh: 臣之所言當也，願時速施行；
sourceUnits.en: If I am right, enact this swiftly;
sourceUnits.literal: If what your servant says is right, I wish it swiftly enacted;

sourceUnits.zh: 非也，登加罪戮，使天下知朝廷從善如流，罰惡不淹。
sourceUnits.en: if not, punish me, so the realm knows the court follows good like flowing water and punishes evil without delay.
sourceUnits.literal: If not, add punishment and execution, so the realm knows the court follows good like flowing water and punishes evil without delay.

sourceUnits.zh: 王憲、劉明，忠臣也，願宥忤鱗之愆，收其藥石之效。
sourceUnits.en: Wang Xian and Liu Ming are loyal ministers; pardon their bluntness and gather the benefit of their medicine-stone counsel.
sourceUnits.literal: Wang Xian and Liu Ming are loyal ministers; I wish their offense of ruffling scales pardoned and the effect of their medicine-stone counsel gathered.

sourceUnits.zh: 皝乃令曰：「覽封記室之諫，孤實懼焉。
sourceUnits.en: Huang then issued an order, saying: “On reading the remonstrance of Recorder Feng, I am truly afraid.
sourceUnits.literal: Huang thereupon ordered, saying: “Having read Secretary Feng’s remonstrance, I truly fear it.

sourceUnits.zh: 君以黎元為國，黎元以穀為命。
sourceUnits.en: The ruler exists for his people; the people live on grain.
sourceUnits.literal: The lord takes the black-haired people as the state; the black-haired people take grain as life.

sourceUnits.zh: 然則農者，國之本也，而二千石令長不遵孟春之令，惰農弗勸，宜以尤不修辟者措之刑法，肅厲屬城。
sourceUnits.en: Agriculture is the foundation, yet magistrates ignore spring plowing—those who leave fields idle should face punishment to wake the commanderies.
sourceUnits.literal: Then farming is the state’s root, yet two-thousand-bushel magistrates and county chiefs do not obey the first month’s orders, lazy farmers are not urged—ought with blame on those who do not cultivate wasteland apply to them criminal law, to awe and encourage dependent cities.

sourceUnits.zh: 主者明詳推檢，具狀以聞。
sourceUnits.en: Let bureaus audit every case and report in full.
sourceUnits.literal: Let the responsible officials clearly examine and push investigation, submit full reports to be heard.

sourceUnits.zh: 苑囿悉可罷之，以給百姓無田業者。
sourceUnits.en: Close the hunting reserves and give that land to landless peasants.
sourceUnits.literal: Hunting parks all can be abolished, to give to common people without fields or occupations.

sourceUnits.zh: 貧者全無資產，不能自存，各賜牧牛一頭。
sourceUnits.en: Give each destitute household a draft ox.
sourceUnits.literal: Poor persons wholly lack assets, cannot preserve themselves—each grant one herding ox.

sourceUnits.zh: 若私有餘力，樂取官牛墾官田者，其依魏、晉舊法。
sourceUnits.en: Whoever wishes to rent state oxen and state land may do so under Wei–Jin precedent.
sourceUnits.literal: If private surplus strength, happy to take official oxen to reclaim official fields, let it follow Wei and Jin old laws.

sourceUnits.zh: 溝洫溉灌，有益官私，主者量造，務盡水陸之勢。
sourceUnits.en: Dig irrigation works for public and private good—let engineers plan every channel.
sourceUnits.literal: Ditches and channels irrigation pour, benefit public and private; let the responsible officials measure and build, exhaust the advantage of water and land.

sourceUnits.zh: 中州未平，兵難不息，勳誠既多，官僚不可以減也。
sourceUnits.en: The heartland is not yet pacified, warfare does not cease, and many have rendered meritorious and loyal service, so the official establishment cannot be reduced.
sourceUnits.literal: The central plain is not yet pacified; military difficulty does not cease; merit and loyalty are already many—bureaucracy cannot be reduced.

sourceUnits.zh: 待克平凶醜，徐更議之。
sourceUnits.en: We will revisit staff cuts after victory.
sourceUnits.literal: Wait until we crush the villains, slowly again deliberate it.

sourceUnits.zh: 百工商賈數，四佐與列將速定大員，余者還農。
sourceUnits.en: Cap tradesmen and aides to fixed quotas; everyone else goes back to the plow.
sourceUnits.literal: Hundred crafts and merchants’ numbers, four assistants and column generals quickly fix great quotas; the rest return to farming.

sourceUnits.zh: 學生不任訓教者，亦除員錄。
sourceUnits.en: Strike idle students from the rolls.
sourceUnits.literal: Students who do not bear training and teaching, also remove from rolls.

sourceUnits.zh: 夫人臣關言於人主，至難也，妖妄不經之事皆應蕩然不問，擇其善者而從之。
sourceUnits.en: For a minister to offer words that touch his ruler is most difficult; wild and baseless matters should all be brushed aside without inquiry, while one chooses what is good and follows it.
sourceUnits.literal: For a minister to present words to his sovereign is most difficult; absurd and unfounded matters should all be set aside without inquiry, while one chooses what is good and follows it.

sourceUnits.zh: 王憲、劉明雖其罪應禁黜，亦猶孤之無大量也。
sourceUnits.en: Wang Xian and Liu Ming, although their offenses would warrant ban and dismissal, also show my own lack of forbearance.
sourceUnits.literal: Wang Xian and Liu Ming although their crimes ought to be banned and dismissed, also is my lacking great measure.

sourceUnits.zh: 可悉復本官，仍居諫司。
sourceUnits.en: They may all be restored to their original offices and still serve in the remonstrance bureau.
sourceUnits.literal: Can all restore original offices, still dwell in remonstrance offices.

sourceUnits.zh: 封生蹇蹇，深得王臣之體。
sourceUnits.en: Feng Yu spoke as a true minister should.
sourceUnits.literal: Feng Sheng staunchly upright, deeply attained the body of a royal minister.

sourceUnits.zh: 《詩》不云乎：'無言不酬。
sourceUnits.en: As the Odes says, “No word goes unanswered.”
sourceUnits.literal: The Odes does it not say: “No word without answer.”

sourceUnits.zh: '其賜錢五萬，明宣內外，有欲陳孤過者，不拘貴賤，勿有所諱。」
sourceUnits.en: So award him fifty thousand cash, and clearly announce inside and outside that whoever wishes to state my faults, whether noble or base, need have no taboo.”
sourceUnits.literal: Grant cash fifty thousand; clearly proclaim inside and outside: whoever wishes to state my faults, not constrained noble or base, do not have what is taboo.”

sourceUnits.zh: 時有黑龍、白龍各一，見於龍山，皝親率群僚觀之，去龍二百餘步，祭乙太宰。
sourceUnits.en: A black dragon and a white dragon appeared on Long Mountain; Huang led his court within two hundred paces and offered the great sacrifice.
sourceUnits.literal: At the time there were black dragon and white dragon each one, appeared at Long Mountain; Huang personally led the group of officials to observe them, two hundred-odd steps from the dragons, sacrificed with the grand boar offering.

sourceUnits.zh: 二龍交首嬉翔，解角而去。
sourceUnits.en: The two dragons crossed their heads, sported and soared, shed their horns, and departed.
sourceUnits.literal: The two dragons crossed heads, sported and soared, shed horns and departed.

sourceUnits.zh: 皝大悅，還宮，赦其境內，號新宮曰和龍，立龍翔佛寺於山上。
sourceUnits.en: Huang was greatly pleased, returned to the palace, pardoned those within his borders, named the new palace Helong, and built the Longxiang Buddhist monastery on the mountain.
sourceUnits.literal: Huang was greatly pleased, returned to the palace, pardoned those within his borders, named the new palace Helong, and established the Longxiang Buddhist temple on the mountain.

sourceUnits.zh: 慕容恪攻高句麗南蘇，克之，置戍而還。
sourceUnits.en: Murong Ke attacked Goguryeo’s Nansu, took it, posted a garrison, and returned.
sourceUnits.literal: Murong Ke attacked Goguryeo’s Nansu, took it, set garrison and returned.

sourceUnits.zh: 三年，遣其世子俊與恪率騎萬七千東襲夫餘，克之，虜其王及部眾五萬餘口以還。
sourceUnits.en: In the third year he sent his heir Jun and Ke with seventeen thousand cavalry to raid Puyu eastward; they took it, captured its king and more than fifty thousand of the tribe, and returned.
sourceUnits.literal: In the third year, sent his heir apparent Jun with Ke leading cavalry seventeen thousand east to raid Puyu, took it, captured their king and division host over fifty thousand mouths and returned.

sourceUnits.zh: 皝親臨東庠考試學生，其經通秀異者，擢充近侍。
sourceUnits.en: He tested students at the eastern school and promoted the best as attendants.
sourceUnits.literal: Huang personally arrived at the eastern school to examine students; those whose classics were thorough and outstanding, promoted to fill close attendance.

sourceUnits.zh: 以久旱，丐百姓田租。
sourceUnits.en: He remitted rent during a drought.
sourceUnits.literal: Because of long drought, begged off common people’s field rent.

sourceUnits.zh: 罷成周、冀陽、營丘等郡。
sourceUnits.en: He abolished several empty commanderies such as Chengzhou, Jiyang, and Yingqiu.
sourceUnits.literal: Abolished Chengzhou, Jiyang, Yingqiu, and other commanderies.

sourceUnits.zh: 以勃海人為興集縣，河間人為寧集縣，廣平、魏郡人為興平縣，東萊、北海人為育黎縣，吳人為吳縣，悉隸燕國。
sourceUnits.en: He grouped refugees from Bohai, Hejian, Guangping, Wei, Donglai, Beihai, and Wu into new counties under Yan.
sourceUnits.literal: Made Bohai people Xingji county, Hejian people Ningji county, Guangping and Wei commandery people Xingping county, Donglai and Beihai people Yuli county, Wu people Wu county—all subordinate to the state of Yan.

sourceUnits.zh: 皝嘗畋於西鄙，將濟河，見一父老，服硃衣，乘白馬，舉手麾皝曰：「此非獵所，王其還也。」
sourceUnits.en: While hunting on the western frontier Murong Huang was about to cross a river when he saw an old man in cinnabar robes on a white horse, who waved him off and said, "This is not a place for hunting; Your Majesty should return."
sourceUnits.literal: Huang once hunted on the western border, about to cross the River, saw an old man, dressed cinnabar robes, riding a white horse, raised hand and waved Huang, saying: “This is not a hunting place; the king ought to return.”

sourceUnits.zh: 秘之不言，遂濟河，連日大獲。
sourceUnits.en: He kept silent, crossed the river, and enjoyed great sport for days.
sourceUnits.literal: He concealed it and did not speak, thereupon crossed the River, continuously days great catch.

sourceUnits.zh: 後見白兔，馳射之，馬倒被傷，乃說所見。
sourceUnits.en: Later he charged a white hare, was thrown and hurt, and told the omen.
sourceUnits.literal: Later saw white hare, galloped and shot it; horse fell and he was injured, then narrated what he had seen.

sourceUnits.zh: 輦而還宮，引俊屬以後事。
sourceUnits.en: They carried him home; he briefed Murong Jun on the succession.
sourceUnits.literal: Carried on litter returned palace, led Jun to entrust later affairs.

sourceUnits.zh: 以永和四年死，在位十五年，時年五十二。
sourceUnits.en: He died in Yonghe 4 (348 CE) after fifteen years on the throne, aged fifty-two.
sourceUnits.literal: Died in the fourth year of Yonghe, fifteen years on the throne, age fifty-two sui.

sourceUnits.zh: 俊僭號，追諡文明皇帝。
sourceUnits.en: After Murong Jun took the throne he posthumously styled his father Emperor Wenming.
sourceUnits.literal: When Jun illegitimately assumed imperial title, posthumously honored him as Emperor Wenming.

sourceIssues.reason: Supplied Chinese ends with anomalous 祭乙太宰; from this packet alone the sacrifice wording cannot be fixed, so it is left unresolved without silent emendation.
Sacrifice clause cannot be given a definite English rite while 祭乙太宰 stands; distance and observation are repaired, offering left uncertain.
Literal sacrifice rendering is blocked by anomalous 祭乙太宰; grand-boar and silent 太牢 readings are rejected without resolving the wording.
邇者 may be temporal recently or nearby people as subject of 副; current you-have-fulfilled reading is one unprovable choice, so no emendation.
Same 邇者/副 uncertainty as en; literal likewise uses recently you have fulfilled without proving that subject.
意在無責 is unsettled between not assigning blame and aiming to be without culpability; meant no offense is not proved.
Literal intent was not to blame chooses one reading of 意在無責; left uncertain without a conjectural replacement.
